title: Bloodline Awakening
next_chapter_hook: Tianji Record completeness rises to forty percent, the seal on the third page completely lifted—an unprecedented foresight power spreads from Chen Ji's brow center. He finally sees the face that has been watching him in the shadows.

text.content:
Holy Sect underground secret realm, the dark passage filled with remnants of ancient aura. Chen Ji, drenched in blood, the long sword in his hand still dripping with unknown black blood, behind him dozens of Holy Sect guard corpses. He had forced his way in, cutting through three layers of formations, expecting the Holy Sect main forces' encirclement—yet at the passage's end stood a stone gate emanating a vast ancient presence.

Carved unmistakably on the stone gate was the character 'Chen.'

It was the Chen family emblem, unseen for a thousand years.

dialogue.content:
The Chen family's ancestral land... how could it be beneath the Holy Sect?

(Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his surging thoughts, fingertips touching the cold stone gate. In that instant, a bloodline resonance exploded like thunder within his body, sending him staggering back three steps. The 'Chen' character on the gate shimmered with golden light, resonating with his dormant bloodline.)

text.content:
The stone gate opened silently, a pressure sufficient to make even Nascent Soul cultivators' souls tremble gushed forth like a tide. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes—the Tianji Record vibrated frantically in his Mental Sea—not a warning, but... excitement?

Deep within the passage, a hazy figure sat cross-legged in the Void, surrounded by countless golden runes. Those runes Chen Ji knew too well—they were precisely the text from the Tianji Record.

The figure slowly raised its head, revealing a face seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's.

dialogue.content:
"Descendant... you have finally arrived."

(Chen Ji froze throughout his body—that voice seemed to travel from antiquity, carrying the weight of years and endless exhaustion. Staring at that familiar face, the portrait the Mo Xiansheng on the Tianji Record's first page had shown him overlapped with it—)

"Are you... Ancestor Chen Xuan?!"

text.content:
The phantom nodded slightly, a glimmer of relief flashing in those eyes that had witnessed all of life's tribulations.

"I have waited for you too long, heir of the Chen bloodline. The Tianji Record chose you, which means you shall bear my unfinished cause—the chess game against the Eye of Heavenly Providence."

Before the words finished, Chen Xuan's remnant soul suddenly transformed into countless golden motes of light, merging into Chen Ji's brow center. In an instant, a tearing agony erupted from the depths of his bloodline, as if ten thousand blades were scraping through his blood vessels.

This was not inheritance—this was... awakening!

choice.prompt: The agony of bloodline awakening surged like tides, Chen Ji's body beginning to undergo astonishing changes. Yet at this moment, he sensed Chen Nian's aura nearby—she too was enduring the pain of bloodline awakening, but due to her young age, she struggled to sustain it.

choices.description: Pour all consciousness into the awakening, completing the transformation at the fastest speed. Only by becoming stronger can one truly protect one's sister.
choices.visible_cost: Bloodline awakening speed accelerates, but may be unable to attend to Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Secondary bloodline awakening completion higher, cultivation breakthrough more stable
choices.risk_hint: Chen Nian may fail in awakening due to lack of guidance, leaving hidden dangers

text.content:
Chen Ji sat cross-legged, allowing the bloodline power to rampage wildly through his body. Using the Tianji Record Fragment as an anchor point, he tamed that berserk force bit by bit. Golden light burst forth from the acupoints around his body, condensing into a vague phantom behind him—the Chen family ancestor's divine manifestation.

The barrier of early Nascent Soul stage shattered under the bloodline's impact, an unprecedented power rising from his dantian. Yet at this moment, he detected a weak cry of pain nearby—Chen Nian's voice.

choices.text: Divert attention to protect Chen Nian's awakening
choices.description: Though the bloodline was berserk, Chen Ji used his powerful divine sense to separate a strand, remotely protecting his sister's heart meridian. His own awakening would be slower, but at least Chen Nian would not come to harm.
choices.visible_cost: Bloodline awakening speed slows, will endure double the pain during the process
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian simultaneously receives bloodline inheritance, sibling bond deepens
choices.risk_hint: Divided attention during awakening may lead to power losing control
choices.process_label: divine sense thread shields Chen Nian

text.content:
Chen Ji's brow center throbbed with excruciating pain, the agony of divine sense division multiplied the difficulties of his awakening path countless times. Yet without hesitation, he channeled a pure strand of bloodline power toward where Chen Nian was.

In that instant, two golden pillars of light resonated across the depths of the secret realm, the siblings' bloodlines creating a resonance. Chen Nian's pain greatly diminished, while Chen Ji had to bear both his own awakening agony and share his sister's torment from the blood pulse collisions.

Just as Chen Ji fell into the critical moment of bloodline awakening, a cold, sinister laughter suddenly echoed from the depths of the secret realm.

"What a touching sibling affection drama."

A wisp of black fog pierced through the formation like a venomous snake, coalescing before Chen Ji into an enchanting figure—it was Ye Qing. Her expression cold, yet her eyes flickered with complex light.

"The Holy Sect forces are arriving. That old fox Ling Yuan calculated long ago that you would come—three senior elders have been sent to block the secret realm entrance."

Her demonic path mist spread quietly, shrouding Chen Ji's entire body, concealing the berserk bloodline aura without a trace.

dialogue.content:
(Ye Qing's voice dropped extremely low) Your current state cannot fight at all. The Holy Sect is serious this time—even the sect's treasure has been summoned.

Chen Ji, I ask you one final time—do you trust me?

choice.prompt: Chen Ji was at the critical moment of bloodline awakening—if interrupted now, at best his cultivation would regress, at worst he would go into demonic deviation. Ye Qing's arrival complicated the situation—she was the Holy Sect Saint, should be mortal enemies with the Holy Sect, yet appeared before Chen Ji claiming to help.

choices.description: The prophecy the Tianji Record once displayed came true—Ye Qing indeed appeared at this moment and offered help. He chose to place his back to her.
choices.visible_cost: Entrusting one's life to another, if Ye Qing harbors treachery, it will be eternal doom
choices.visible_reward: Receiving Ye Qing's Demonic Path Mist protection, the awakening process proceeds undisturbed
choices.risk_hint: Though the Demonic Path Mist can conceal presence, Ye Qing's true intentions remain unknown

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing freezes for an instant, then a complex curve forms at the corner of her lips) You are far more decisive than I anticipated. With that, demonic energy churns around her as jet-black runes sink into Chen Ji's body, devouring all the leaked energy from the bloodline awakening.

choices.description: Ye Qing can help, but Chen Ji secretly keeps a trump card—he conceals a thread of Tianji Record's power within Chen Nian as his final reserve.
choices.visible_cost: Dividing attention for vigilance, awakening efficiency decreases slightly
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining Ye Qing's assistance while retaining countermeasures
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing discovers his vigilance, it may affect the relationship between them

text.content: Ye Qing's Demonic Path Mist descends, and Chen Ji senses no malice within that power, yet he still secretly leaves a contingency. The Tianji power within Chen Nian is like an invisible thread, capable of reversing the situation at any moment. After completing this, Chen Ji truly immerses himself in the awakening.

Golden light surges through the depths of the secret realm as countless ancient visions flash through Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a carousel—the Chen clan's ancestors' fierce battle against the Heavenly Eye, erased historical truths, the true origins of the Tianji Record... Simultaneously, an ancient voice echoes within the awakening: 'Tianji Nine Transformations, first transformation: Divine Mechanism, second transformation: Heavenly Eye, third transformation: Fate Reversal... Since you have inherited my bloodline, you must carry forth my unfinished ambition...' Chen Xuan's remnant soul is completely merging into Chen Ji's bloodline, transforming his lifetime of knowledge into Chen Ji's instinct.

BOOM— The barrier of mid Transformation God Stage shatters under the bloodline's impact! Before Chen Ji can catch his breath, that berserk power coalesces once more, transforming into a towering pillar of golden light— Late Transformation God Stage! Just as everyone believes the awakening is ending, that power shows no signs of stopping, instead charging toward the next barrier with even more ferocious intensity— The void around Chen Ji begins to distort as strands of principle power coil around him like chains. Within his Mental Sea, the seal on the third page of the Tianji Record starts to crack. He intends to... directly cross a major realm!

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's pupils constrict) This lunatic... he intends to directly breakthrough to Golden Core Stage?! (She bites her tongue, spraying refined blood onto the Demonic Path Mist, forcibly stabilizing this space) Hold on... you fool... (Ye Qing's face turns ashen white, clearly this support places enormous burden on her, yet the light in her eyes grows increasingly resolute)

text.content: At this moment, earth-shaking rumbling echoes from the secret realm's entrance. Three figures descend like deities, emanating pressure that makes heaven and earth change color—these are the Holy Sect's three great elders, all pinnacle Unity Stage experts! 'Bold madman, how dare you trespass the Holy Sect's Forbidden Grounds!' 'Chen clan remnants, today marks your death!' Yet when they witness that towering pillar of golden light, their expressions shift in unison—it is a bloodline awakening phenomenon, and one occurring with such intense ferocity.

choice.prompt: The three great elders' pressure bears down like mountain ranges, Ye Qing's Demonic Path Mist being gradually dismantled. However, the bloodline awakening has reached its most critical juncture; if interrupted now, Chen Ji risks severe injury at minimum, or even demonic deviation at worst.

choices.text: Forcibly interrupt the awakening to engage in combat
choices.description: Can no longer burden Ye Qing; even at self-sacrifice, must interrupt the awakening to delay the three great elders. Cultivation regression is far better than both perishing together.
choices.visible_cost: Bloodline awakening interrupted, cultivation impaired, potential hidden injuries remain
choices.visible_reward: Demonstrate responsibility, protect Ye Qing and Chen Nian, buy time
choices.risk_hint: After awakening interruption, Chen Ji will face the cost of cultivation regression

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing seizes Chen Ji's wrist) You're insane! Interrupting now means certain death! Give me three more breaths! (She violently bites all ten fingers; as blood drips, the Demonic Path Mist surges abruptly, forcefully isolating the three great elders' pressure outside)

choices.text: Trust Ye Qing and continue breaking through
choices.description: Since Ye Qing dares let him continue, she must have hidden cards. Chen Ji chooses to trust the vision he saw through the Tianji Record—she will not betray.
choices.visible_cost: If Ye Qing cannot hold on, both will fall into desperate peril together
choices.visible_reward: Bloodline awakening completes in full, cultivation soaring to mid Golden Core Stage
choices.risk_hint: Entrusting his life completely to Ye Qing, betting that she wouldn't let him down

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, ignoring all external threats. He severed every distracting thought, using the Tianji Record as the core to guide his bloodline power in crashing through that final barrier.

One breath... two breaths... three breaths...

The golden pillar of light suddenly contracted, transforming into a dazzling golden elixir that hovered in Chen Ji's dantian.

Golden Core Middle Stage!

He had successfully crossed an entire major realm!

dialogue.content:
"Well done, successor. The Tianji Record has reached 40% completeness, and the third page's abilities have fully awakened."

(Mo Xiansheng's voice carried rare approval)

"With your current strength, you still can't defeat the three elders in direct combat, but you now have the power to fight. Moreover..."

(His voice became deeply meaningful)

"Your demonic path Holy Sect friend is far more formidable than you realize."

text.content:
Before the words finished, the demonic energy around Ye Qing suddenly surged a thousandfold! A jet-black divine rune appeared at her brow—the mark of the supreme secret technique from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path—

"Demonic Path·Myriad Transformations Return to One!"

A black vortex that could devour heaven and earth exploded outward from Ye Qing's center. The combined pressure of the three elders was actually shattered! One elder failed to dodge in time, half his body dragged into the vortex, and a凄惨的惨叫声 echoed through the secret realm.

The other two elders' faces changed drastically, turning to flee without hesitation.

"Holy Maiden! How dare you betray the Holy Sect!"

Ye Qing coldly watched the two fleeing figures, her lips curving into a mocking arc.

dialogue.content:
Betrayal?

(Ye Qing recalled her demonic energy, her face pale as translucent, yet laughing wildly)

I was never a person of the Holy Sect.

(She turned to look at Chen Ji, the coldness in her eyes completely fading, replaced by an inexplicable tenderness)

The prophecy you showed me back then... I've been waiting twenty years for this day.

text.content:
At the same time, on the other side of the secret realm, Chen Nian's awakening was reaching its finale. Pale golden light surrounded her body as her cultivation directly jumped from Foundation Building to Nascent Soul Late Stage, crossing three entire major realms!

The brother and sister's bloodlines produced a profound resonance, intertwining in the void into a brilliant halo.

Chen Nian slowly opened her eyes, her gaze toward Chen Ji filled with tears and filial longing.

"Brother... I found you..."

The softest place in Chen Ji's heart was struck hard. He stepped forward, pulling his sister into a tight embrace.

"I'm sorry... for making you wait so long."

Ye Qing quietly watched the siblings reuniting after their ordeal, her smile gradually softening. She suddenly spoke:

"That old fox Ling Yuan won't give up easily. His true goal isn't to kill you, but to—seize the Tianji Record."

(She looked at the fading soul of Mo Xiansheng in Chen Ji's arms, her expression growing solemn)

"Based on intelligence I've gathered over these years, he began his scheme a century ago. The Holy Sect, the Xuanwu Sect, even the Tianqing Sect... the war between the three sects was all part of his calculations."

"What are you planning to do next?"

choice.prompt: The bloodline awakening completed, cultivation broke through, and Chen Nian was safely recovered. However, the information Ye Qing revealed made the situation far more complex—Ling Yuan's ambition exceeded imagination, and the war between the three sects might only be one move in his grand scheme. Chen Ji needed to decide his next direction of action.

choices.text: Take the initiative to strike at the heart of the enemy
choices.description: Since Ling Yuan has already been exposed, why not take the initiative and strike while he's not fully prepared? With Chen Ji's current strength, plus the Tianji Nine Transformations and Ye Qing's assistance, victory is not impossible.
choices.visible_cost: Going deep into enemy territory alone carries tremendous risk
choices.visible_reward: If successful, it could completely reverse the entire war situation
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan has been scheming for a hundred years—would he not have backup plans?

text.content:
A cold smile curved Chen Ji's lips. So what if Ling Yuan has plotted for a century? Chen Ji has the Tianji Record in hand, the Tianji Nine Transformations at his side, and even a strategic-level ally like Ye Qing.

If the other party wants to play chess, then let him see who the true chess master is.

choices.description: Ling Yuan has been scheming for a hundred years with deep roots—不可轻视. Chen Ji decided to first consolidate the forces at hand—Ye Qing, Chen Nian, even Su Qingyao—then slowly work toward his goal.
choices.visible_cost: Time is needed for positioning, which may give Ling Yuan breathing room
choices.visible_reward: Once forces are consolidated, there will be capital to directly confront Ling Yuan
choices.risk_hint: The longer time stretches, the more variables multiply

text.content:
Chen Ji shook his head. Recklessness is a luxury only the weak can afford. Since he chose this path, he must prepare thoroughly.

Ling Yuan has been plotting for a hundred years, so he'll use ten years to break this game.

For now, he must first take his sister and Ye Qing away from here, and then... it's time to contact Su Qingyao.

Just at this moment, a sharp pain pierced Chen Ji's brow center. The third page ability of the Tianji Record—the second transformation of Tianji Nine Transformations, "Heavenly Eye"—activated automatically.

In an instant, he "saw" something.

Deep within the Holy Sect, a pair of eyes penetrated the endless void, staring directly at him. Those eyes held no emotion whatsoever, yet they made all his body hairs stand on end.

That was... the Eyes of Heavenly Way!

At the same time, a voice rang in his Mental Sea:

"You've finally reached this step, successor of the Chen family."

"We... can finally meet properly."

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, cold sweat soaking his back. He looked up at the void as if he could see those transcendent eyes smiling.

Ye Qing sensed his unusual state and frowned:

"What's wrong?"

Chen Ji took a deep breath and shook his head.

"Nothing... I just saw something interesting."

He lowered his gaze to the Tianji Record in his arms, a meaningful arc curling at the corner of his lips.

The Eyes of Heavenly Way want to meet him?

Then let it wait.

He, Chen Ji, is never anyone's chess piece.

The Tianji Record's completeness increased to forty percent, the third page's seal completely released, and an unprecedented power of foresight spread from Chen Ji's brow center—he finally saw clearly the face that had been secretly watching him all along.
